description: Risks to delivering an accepted Causa build in the 420-minute window. Likelihood and impact are 1 (low) to 3 (high); exposure = likelihood x impact. Each risk names the requirements, invariants, work items or owner decision requests that mitigate it.

risks.title: The timed plan does not fit 420 minutes with one lead agent
risks.trigger: execution-plan.json B-single-lead makespan exceeds the window
risks.mitigation: Approve role lanes (ODR-V4-07); integration checkpoints T17 and T21; reserves in execution-policy.json

risks.title: Owner decision requests ODR-V4-01..07 are not decided before kickoff
risks.trigger: approvals file still empty at kickoff
risks.mitigation: v4 stays a CANDIDATE; the build follows the baseline obligations; proposed clauses are reported as not normative

risks.title: GitHub answer forms differ from the fake (moved head, secondary rate limits, lost answers)
risks.mitigation: Live probe first (T18) and fake built from recorded answers (PF-013); INV-22

risks.title: A fix introduces a new defect late (Rehearsal 7: the second remediation caused the third review's race)
risks.trigger: a review round finds a defect introduced by the previous fix
risks.mitigation: Independent review after every fix round (IRC-1..3); invariant property tests and mutation checks; DCC-014 ratchet

risks.title: Deployed WebKit acceptance stops early and leaves tests NOT_RUN
risks.trigger: runner stops after the first failure
risks.mitigation: Suites run to completion (execution-policy ciRules); acceptance gate AG-05

risks.title: Green work left unmerged at the deadline; clock misjudged after idle
risks.trigger: a resumption computes remaining time from memory
risks.mitigation: Absolute deadline and wall-clock rule; merge-on-green; merge freeze at deadline - 45

risks.title: Read and write tokens missing or over-privileged at kickoff
risks.mitigation: K6/T05 owner action; missing secret yields BLOCKED, not PASS (PF-015-O5)

risks.title: Built against the candidate data contract instead of the frozen one
risks.mitigation: IF-STORAGE note: CONTRACT.md wins; T15 golden replay and T25 live catalog check early

risks.title: Forma token names or components used that do not exist in 0.12.0
risks.trigger: CSS falls back to browser defaults

risks.title: Rehearsal code reused for the event
risks.mitigation: PERSIST-026; ODR-V4-02 extends the comparison to Rehearsal 7; independent verifier runs it

risks.title: main has no ruleset, so the merge gate is advisory
risks.mitigation: Owner adds a ruleset requiring build, independent review and CI on the event repository before kickoff (Rehearsal 7 recommendation 6)

risks.title: Organizer confirmation for prepared data and requirements (PRE-ORG-01) not obtained
risks.mitigation: Owner obtains it before the event (ADRP-016)

risks.title: Approval records are text in a file; their authenticity rests on git attribution and main's protection
risks.trigger: a record written by someone other than the operator is merged
risks.mitigation: FG-05 refuses records from agent-attributed commits or off main and from untrusted approvers; the owner should require their own approving review on pull requests that change kickoff/*/approvals.causa.json

risks.title: The schedule's slack is 15 minutes on author estimates
risks.trigger: any timed task overruns its estimate
risks.mitigation: Topology C (ODR-V4-07); review checkpoints T35 and T36 catch defects early; reserves RES-INTEGRATION and RES-FINAL are kept
